# Minimalist data wrangling with python

Some quick and dirty notes from Minimalist Data Wrangling with Python.

## Ch 4

```{python}
import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

mpl.use("kitcat")

heights = np.genfromtxt(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gagolews/teaching-data/master/marek/nhanes_adult_female_height_2020.txt"
)
print(f"heights variable: {heights[:6]}")

cities = np.genfromtxt(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gagolews/teaching-data/refs/heads/master/marek/population_largest_cities_unnamed.txt"
)

print(f"cities variable: {cities[:6]}")

counts, bins, _not_important = plt.hist(
    heights, bins=11, color="lightgrey", edgecolor="black"
)
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.show()
```
